host_note: Host: Pseudomonas syringae pv. phaseolicola. Membrane predictions refer to a generic membrane context (cytoplasmic vs non-cytoplasmic side); no specific host membrane is assigned, and these are not viral-envelope predictions. phi6 is enveloped and its genome has three segments (L, M, S); these predictions do not assign any protein to the virion envelope.

proteins.note: P2 protein; Carries out transcription and genome replication inside a large icosahedral complex formed with 4 other viral proteins (inner core). However, purified P2 protein is active. Accepts single and double-stranded RNA as templates and is capable of de novo initiation. Structurally related to Hepatitis C virus RdRP. other names: P2

proteins.note: P4 protein; P4 is a hexameric packaging NTPase which belongs to the DnaB-like family. Though there is no sequence similarity, the NTP binding domain bears striking structural similarity to RecA/F1-ATPase-like motors. 12 hexamers of P4 are found at the 5-fold vertices of the procapsid and use ATP hydrolysis to actively transport L, M and S segments into the procapsid. RNA segments are packaged in order
